“Since she’s the one I listened to when she complained, or when she boasted, or even sometimes when she said nothing at all. Since she’s my rose.”


*The Little Prince* is a short story written by French writer Antoine de Saint-Exupéry in 1942. It is told from the perspective of “I”, a pilot in distress, who meets and becomes friends with the little prince. The author projects the emptiness, blindness, foolishness and rigid dogma of adults from an innocent point of view, and writes in plain language about the fate of human beings who are lonely, rootless and wandering with the wind.


The whole story is clearly written and simple in form, but it flows with poetic melancholy and faint sorrow, which is evocative.


On August 14, The latest work “rose is a rose is a rose is a rose” (hereinafter referred to as “rose”) by renowned Chinese crypto artist Song Ting will be available through the platforms of Heco, Cortex, Mints and IcarusArt. Among them, there are two special custom-made blossoms standing alone in the world, waiting to be picked up by the right person.


As the record holder of 2020 Chinese AI and blockchain art auction, the most promising crypto artist of 2020 in FAT list, the most popular creator of the year in Overlook-Future Conference(瞰见·未来大会), and the science and art advisor of OPPO Campus Technology and Sina Weibo, Song Ting’s new work “Rose” has received wide attention from many collectors at home and abroad from the first moment it was announced.

To pursue your own quest 去追寻自己的追求


These two special roses each have different stories and backgrounds from which they derive their different personalities and pursuits.


But what they have in common is that they all represent the artist Song Ting’s own attitude towards love: passionate, persistent, brave, and once determined, reckless.


“Taming” is one of the most important concepts in the story of *The Little Prince* .


In the story, the little prince was once tired of his lonely, self-loathing rose and gambled on a journey to Earth. Upon arriving on Earth, the young prince is extraordinarily frustrated to see five thousand roses identical to his own; but after taming a fox, the little prince rediscovers the uniqueness and preciousness of his own rose.


He said to the five thousand roses: “You’re beautiful, but you’re empty…One couldn’t die for you. Of course, an ordinary passerby would think my rose looked just like you. But my rose, all on her own, is more important than all of you together, since she’s the one I’ve watered. Since she’s the one I put under glass, since she’s the one I sheltered behind the screen. Since she’s the one for whom I killed the caterpillars (except the two or three butterflies). Since she’s the one I listened to when she complained, or when she boasted, or even sometimes when she said nothing at all. Since she’s my rose.”


Press enter or click to view image in full size


**Unlike all the usual crypto artworks, “Rose” has the sense of thoughtfulness in the palm of your hand.**


rct AI uses the Chaos Box algorithm and AI technology to give the two roses different souls and personalities. They are not just artworks to be viewed from afar, but a pair of virtual creatures with thoughts, love and hate, who can talk to the collector on a daily basis, share emotions, interact with each other and even fall in love.


After much interaction and companionship, polished by time, an intimate relationship that once belonged only to human beings will be established between the rose and the collector.


In addition to the “uniqueness” granted by digital encryption, the rose and the collector will tame each other in their emotions and memories, becoming the “unique” one: “my rose”.


“They loved each other fiercely, yet tormented each other, often conflicted, unable to stay together for long, but she remained the most important person in his life. Once a man makes a choice, he is content with the contingencies in his life, he goes on loving his choices, and is subject to them, as is love.” As with the little prince and his rose.

“Rose” conversation test


In the course of our exploration of the Metaverse, we have become increasingly convinced that the true Metaverse should not be defined by people alone. The world itself should be rational, fluid, and logical enough that humans are just accidental intruders, and that it should be able to function within its logic without human involvement.


In order to achieve such a goal, virtual beings, who exist as the natives of the Metaverse, are a necessary prerequisite. They are self-driven, capable of transforming the world and exploring the meaning of its existence on their own; they will also generate dynamic changes in the process of exploration, constantly re-examining their own definition and value in the world.


“She cast her fragrance and her radiance over me. I ought never to have run away from her… I ought to have guessed all the affection that lay behind her poor little stratagems. Flowers are so inconsistent! But I was too young to know how to love her…”


In the past few decades, humans have always sought to make virtual species represented by AI “more human-like”, believing that AI should have the same logic and thoughts as humans, and that AI should look closer and closer to human appearance. But is this really the case?


In various mythologies, humans have invented the concept of creation as “gods”: gods have shaped humans in their own image, and they have dominated their minds from the beginning. In the process of shaping virtual creatures, rct AI decided to break this concept by saying that “everything can have a spirit” and that virtual creatures with intelligence should not be limited to the silhouette of “men”, but also to birds and animals, trees and insects, a table or even a chair can be used as a carrier of thought.


At the same time, the relationship between humans and virtual beings should be more of a dignified community of destiny than a creator and a tool. While creating the Metaverse together, virtual beings will continue to blur and broaden the concept of virtual society outwardly. In the ancient times, human beings moved from individual warfare to tribal gathering, giving rise to villages, cities, nations, and eventually the world; virtual beings with subjective initiative in the virtual world will also spontaneously gather into groups, forming societies, organizations, and becoming ubiquitous, becoming the first impression of the so-called “world as it was” in the eyes of newcomers to the Metaverse. “


In this process, the relationship between humans and virtual creatures will change essentially, beyond the relationship of using and being used, which is a purely instrumental attribute, humans and virtual creatures can establish an emotional connection. Unlike the current face recognition and automatic navigation, in the future world of Metaverse, the objects we interact with deserve to have greater imagination.


“Rose” is an attempt to pursue this path and is a valuable social practice.


The technical framework used in “Rose” is a reuse of technology from previous rct AI projects. Before that, on May 23rd, the world’s first NFT auction held by China’s third largest auction house, Yongle auction, sold the crypto artwork “Nüwa” for the highest price in the room, also shaped by the same technology provided by rct AI.

Nüwa


If “Nüwa” is the mother of the avatars in the Metaverse, then Rose is the first widely used intelligent avatar birthed from “Nüwa”.


In rct AI’s previous work, we were committed to providing customized technical service support for major game manufacturers. For different needs in different scenarios, we designed a variety of solutions covering intelligent object generation, intelligent text generation, intelligent testing, and recommended data algorithms.


Currently, we are hoping to help more small, mid-sized teams and individual developers to come up with a standardized solution process with reuse value in games, NFT, digital images and other areas. Developers do not need to master advanced code and information technology, they can easily give character, persona, mind and “soul” to their digital content.


Thus, the product that was born is Meta Being.

Meta Being is a standardized product that uses deep learning algorithms to create content and has a mature dialogue system module.


With Meta Being, digital content creators can add conversational interaction to any digital content carrier (NPC, NFT or other digital content) in any scenario, adding a dynamic conversational interaction experience with character and vitality to each static digital avatar, making it more intimate, dynamic and accessible.


In the NFT field alone, Meta Being not only helps developers achieve richer creativity, but also increases the interactivity between NFT and collectors, thus enhancing the value of NFT itself and bringing more creative benefits to developers.

People’s definition of “beauty” is always changing, but the only thing that really grips the heart is a tie to the soul, like “rose”.


Press enter or click to view image in full size


In the story of *The Little Prince* , the little prince watered, drove away insects, and painstakingly tended to his rose, and it grew stronger and more exquisite, as if in response to his prayer. Although the little prince leaves the rose to explore the larger world at one point, the rose does not stop him from doing so, but continues to enjoy itself and maintain its most beautiful form.


Because she knows: after seeing more roses, the little prince will eventually return to her; if he never comes back, it means they should never have been together in the first place.


If someone loves a flower of which just one example exists among all the millions and millions of stars, that’s enough to make him happy when he looks at the stars. He tells himself ‘My flower’s up there somewhere…’ But if the sheep eats the flower, then for him it’s as if, suddenly, all the stars went out. And that isn’t important?

Perhaps this is the nature of love.


Perhaps this is the power of love sedimented in the sea of time.
